title: Combina estos pasos de TWERK: Wine y Galop | Tutorial avanzado

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Yohanna Almagro breaks down advanced twerk combos step by step with a friendly, structured approach. She emphasizes smooth transitions and foot placement between movements.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the wine and galop combo exercise
Explanation of combining galop and wine steps using inertia
Detailing the first displacement variation for wine
Detailing the second displacement variation for wine
Detailing the third displacement variation for wine
Practicing the complete sequence without music

cues: No se debería cortar el movimiento
common_mistakes: Cutting the movement short between galop and wine instead of keeping it fluid
Leaving feet too wide apart during certain displacements which prevents proper positioning

steps_taught.name: Galop
steps_taught.description: Knee rotation movement with hip action

steps_taught.name: Wine
steps_taught.description: Circular hip movement combined with static or travelling footwork

what_works: Breaking down multiple displacement variations clearly
Demonstrating from both front and back angles
what_hinders: The fast pace of advanced combinations might be challenging to follow immediately

quotes.text: Hoy vamos a trabajar con dos pasos que ya he explicado anteriormente
Realmente tengo que aprovechar la inercia que he conseguido
Al principio puede que sea un poco de uff, es todo muy parecido

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates galop followed by wine facing away from camera
Demonstrating foot displacement pattern for the first variation

extraction.distinctive_method: Progressive layering of three different foot displacement variations onto the same core wine and galop sequence.
